source: South Carolina DOR 2026 withholding formula (SC-4 basis, NFC bulletin NFC-26-1773173131, eff. pay period 03-2026): standard deduction = lesser of 10% of annual wages or $7,500 when 1+ exemptions claimed; $5,000 deduction per personal exemption; table 0% to $3,640, 3.0% to $18,230, 6.0% above. CLOSEST-FIT EXCEPTIONS: (1) the 10%-of-wages standard deduction for annual wages under $75,000 is not modeled — engine always deducts the $7,500 maximum (under-withholds for wages <$75k); (2) zero-exemption elections receive NO standard deduction under the state formula but our engine still deducts $7,500.
